items.problem: All four migrated features were unreachable because packaged activation crashed, and the final unpackaged workaround removed AppxManifest.xml from build output.
items.evidence: Package.appxmanifest lines 32-34 retained EntryPoint="PlayReady.App"; session-log turns 69-71 captured COMException 0x8001010E at Application.Start; migration-score.json records candidate_launch_status failed and all four features failed.
items.covered_at: MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md > 'Manifest migration checklist (Windows.Desktop + runFullTrust)', item 4, and 'Project File Migration' packaging guidance.
items.proposed_improvement: Promote the documented invariant into Validate-UwpMigration: require EntryPoint="$targetentrypoint$" for every Application and reject WindowsPackageType=None when Package.appxmanifest is retained. Also map the specific Application.Start apartment message to this check.
items.generalizes: The bootstrap copies UWP manifests, whose literal app-class entry points are incompatible with packaged WinUI activation; the same silent build-success/startup-crash pattern can recur in any packaged migration.
